description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelTrait's nested collection normalization functionality within the OrangeHRM project. It defines test cases that verify the correct behavior of normalizing nested collections of objects, specifically Employee objects with supervisor relationships, by invoking private methods using reflection. Additionally, it includes mock classes TestEmployee and EmployeeModel for testing purposes.

classes.name: ModelTraitNormalizeNestedCollectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the normalization of nested collections in the ModelTrait, using mock Employee objects.

classes.name: TestEmployee
classes.description: A mock model class representing an employee with id, name, and supervision relationships, used for testing normalization.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A class implementing the Normalizable interface, using the ModelTrait to handle normalization logic.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollections
methods.description: Tests the normalization of a simple nested collection containing one employee with an id.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollectionsFor
methods.description: Tests the normalization of nested collections with multiple employees and properties (id and name).
